findings.problem: NtCreateFile errors were all io::ErrorKind::Other, so newly fallible ignore resolution rejected missing optional .git/commondir/info/exclude on Windows.
findings.fix: RtlNtStatusToDosError from existing windows-sys Foundation feature, then io::Error::from_raw_os_error. No new FFI or dependency feature.

findings.problem: Git-created .git gitfiles are hidden on Windows; std::fs::write creates/truncates via CREATE_ALWAYS, which rejects existing hidden files. Two corruption fixtures therefore could fail before testing malformed metadata.
findings.fix: Open existing gitfile with write+truncate and no create, then write_all, preserving hidden attributes.
